title: Selective-CDSS: Risk-Controlled Selective Prediction for AI Decision Services under Degraded Data Quality
description:
Reference implementation and analyses for the paper "Risk-Controlled Selective Prediction for AI Decision Services under Degraded Data Quality". A model-agnostic abstention wrapper that sets its threshold with Learn-then-Test, so that the false-negative rate among retained decisions stays below an operator-set level under degraded input data.

The release contains:

  • the testbed (run_eval.py, run_eval_secondary.py);
  • every analysis in the paper in scripts/ictx/: certified and selective-certified LTT rules, the independent-pool test over 50 independently simulated cohorts, per-run subgroups, condition-wise calibration, calibration shift, the SGR and conformal baselines, δ sensitivity and runtime;
  • the JSON outputs and the generators of the supplementary tables and figures.

Every number except wall-clock timing is deterministic from fixed seeds.
